notes: "1 world - 3 combinations": the three frames can be hung in three orders, joined with the kit's connector pins. Kit columns are the columns of combination A (the kit mask, the official design and the projection are defined in them). A layout's x is the column as hung: display column = (kit column + column_shift) mod 128. The grid spans 360 degrees of longitude (kit_31203_projection.json), so every seam is geographically continuous.

source.title: LEGO 31203 World Map building instructions
source.method: Read by hand from pages 7-8 (frame numbers, names and the three combinations); the frame column ranges follow from the 8 x 5 section layout of kit_31203_design.json. Nothing from the PDF is shipped.
